note: Fire-suit crew proving the four-crew framework. Cast is reserved away from all 22 Major Arcana species.

suit.name: Wands
suit.coreRule: All subjects anatomically bird; streetwear fitted to bird anatomy; no humanoid forms; no gore.

cards.name: Ace of Wands
cards.coreMeaning: Spark of inspiration, raw potential, new drive
cards.description: A hummingbird sparks a lone flame-feather alight on a rooftop antenna.
cards.pose: Hovering at full wingbeat beside an antenna, striking a single feather into bright flame.
streetwear: cropped ember bomber over folded wings
cards.varietyNotes: Suit anchor species. Tiny hovering silhouette + single lit feather reads 'spark' instantly.
cards.gameplayFantasy: Opens drive/passion resources; an ignition card that fuels later Wands plays.

cards.name: Two of Wands
cards.description: A swift surveys the skyline from a high ledge between two marked poles.
cards.pose: Perched at a rooftop edge, head turned to scan the horizon, two flagged poles flanking it.
cards.varietyNotes: Long swept swift silhouette and two poles frame the planning beat distinctly.
cards.gameplayFantasy: Scout/plan effect; previews the field or sets up the next Wands play.

cards.name: Three of Wands
cards.description: A bird-of-paradise watches the horizon as three banners ripple behind it.
cards.pose: Standing proud on a high stage rail, plumes flared, gaze on the distance, three banners aloft.
cards.varietyNotes: Lavish flank plumes set the display species apart from the sleek fliers of the suit.
cards.gameplayFantasy: Reach/expansion buff; extends range or readies multiple ventures at once.

cards.name: Four of Wands
cards.description: Flycatchers string festival lights between four poles over a rooftop.
cards.pose: Two bright flycatchers in mid-air, looping a garland of lit bulbs across four ribboned poles.
cards.varietyNotes: Small vivid red flycatchers and strung lights signal the warm home/milestone scene.
cards.gameplayFantasy: Stabilize/anchor effect; rewards securing a position with a lasting bonus.

cards.name: Five of Wands
cards.description: Five young birds clash in a chaotic rooftop dance-battle, sparks flying.
cards.pose: A tangle of five small birds mid-leap and spin, lit wands crossing, ember sparks scattering.
cards.varietyNotes: Crowded five-subject scramble breaks from the solo pips; crimson accent raises the heat.
cards.gameplayFantasy: Skirmish effect; contested play where multiple units fight over one prize.

cards.name: Six of Wands
cards.description: A kestrel is held aloft on a wire above a cheering rooftop crowd.
cards.pose: Wings raised in triumph atop a high wire, a laurel-wand lifted, smaller birds cheering below.
cards.varietyNotes: Compact raptor lifted high above a crowd is the suit's clear triumph silhouette.
cards.gameplayFantasy: Momentum payoff; converts a win into a board-wide morale or tempo boost.

cards.name: Seven of Wands
cards.description: A flycatcher on a high ledge fends off six rivals pressing from below.
cards.pose: Braced atop a ledge, one lit wand swung downward, six grasping wands rising from beneath.
cards.varietyNotes: High-ground lone defender against many keeps the seven readable as 'hold the line'.
cards.gameplayFantasy: Defensive stand; one unit holds against several attackers for a turn.

cards.name: Eight of Wands
cards.description: Eight swifts streak across the sky in tight formation, motion lines trailing.
cards.pose: A diagonal volley of swifts in arrow formation, wings swept, lit wands streaking as comets.
cards.varietyNotes: Mass diagonal formation and motion lines make the eight the fastest-reading card; cyan pops the speed.
cards.gameplayFantasy: Haste/burst effect; rushes multiple actions or accelerates a play this turn.

cards.name: Nine of Wands
cards.description: A battered hummingbird guards a barricade of wands, wary but unbroken.
cards.pose: Bandaged and tensed atop a low barricade of upright wands, one lit wand raised in defense.
cards.varietyNotes: Small but battle-worn behind a wand-fence; smoke-amber accent reads grit over glory.
cards.gameplayFantasy: Endurance/last-stand; a weakened unit gains a defensive bonus to survive one more turn.

cards.name: Ten of Wands
cards.description: A bird hauls a heavy bundle of ten lit wands, hunched under the load.
cards.pose: Bent low under a strapped bundle of ten glowing wands, plumes drooping, trudging forward.
cards.varietyNotes: Drooping plumes and the heavy strapped bundle invert the proud Three into burden.
cards.gameplayFantasy: Overload cost; powerful effect that taxes the unit or slows it next turn.

cards.name: Fledgling of Wands
cards.coreMeaning: Eager spark, bold beginnings, a fiery message
cards.description: The youngest of the Emberwings, a small hummingbird bearing a freshly lit wand.
cards.pose: Bright-eyed and darting along a neon ledge, a tiny lit wand held out ready to deliver.
cards.varietyNotes: Court Fledgling = smallest cast member, messenger energy; distinct tiny hovering silhouette.
cards.gameplayFantasy: Cheap utility/messenger unit; draws or delivers a drive resource.

cards.name: Outrider of Wands
cards.description: The Emberwings' mobile actor, a swift tearing across the neon skyline on a lit charge.
cards.pose: Low blazing flight between rooftops, wings hard-swept, a flaming wand clutched in its talons.
cards.varietyNotes: Court Outrider = always in motion; only dynamic flight pose among the Wands courts.
cards.gameplayFantasy: Mobile striker; carries/charges drive effects across the board.

cards.name: Matron of Wands
cards.description: The inner master of the Emberwings, a bird-of-paradise commanding the stage in full display.
cards.pose: Poised at center stage, plumes fully fanned, a steady lit wand held upright with assurance.
cards.varietyNotes: Court Matron = poised inward mastery; full display plumage distinguishes her from the Elder.
cards.gameplayFantasy: Support/buff leader; amplifies and inspires allied Wands units.

cards.name: Elder of Wands
cards.coreMeaning: Bold leadership, vision in command, fiery authority
cards.description: The crew boss of the Emberwings, a monumental kestrel ruling the rooftops at blazing noon.
cards.pose: Standing tall and still on a high water-tower perch, wings folded, a great lit wand at its side.
cards.varietyNotes: Court Elder = monumental external authority; the crew's kestrel boss at full command.
cards.gameplayFantasy: Faction leader; command effects that rally and embolden the whole Wands crew.
